title: Beyond Benchmark: LLMs Evaluation with an Anthropomorphic and Value-oriented Roadmap
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it is not a focus of the survey. The analysis centers on a general, anthropomorphic framework for LLM evaluation (IQ, EQ, PQ, VQ) without application to specific belief systems.

measurement_description: The paper is a broad survey of LLM evaluation frameworks and does not specifically measure any aspects of faith or religion. It discusses general benchmarks for capabilities like reasoning (IQ), professional knowledge (PQ), and alignment with human values (EQ), but does not apply these to religious contexts.
